coordinate_system.note: World is the first processed LiDAR frame (index 0). ORBIT does not convert to nuScenes global. Sensor-frame points are current-LiDAR XYZ after range filtering. Heading is atan2 of LiDAR +X after T_ego_to_world.

downsample.description: points and world_points share np.round(linspace(0, N-1, max_points)) into mapped XYZ. Full mapped_points stay in metrics.point_count_full.

website_note: The website visualizes exported ORBIT pipeline results. It does not execute perception, mapping, tracking, or world-model algorithms in the browser.
